metadata.description: USAP — Unified Security Agent Platform. Open-source AI cybersecurity skills marketplace.

plugins.name: usap-skills
plugins.description: 79 open-source AI cybersecurity agent skills + 12 cs-* orchestrator agents. 7 slash commands (/usap:run, /usap:fortigate, /usap:orchestrate, /usap:challenge, /usap:compare, /usap:test, /usap:README) and 6 user-invocable skills (Alex, CISO, DevSecOps, IR, Program Manager, Red Team). Every skill emits a typed 11-field JSON output contract mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. Apache 2.0, runs in any LLM.
